delta: Clarify physical CUDA action scope separately from requested semantic query embeddings.

invariants.coding_tools: Original full 23-tool contract and actual captured system payload
invariants.research: Canonical standard /dr with original source, blind gate, optimization and publication contract
invariants.numeric_gate: Original selected-token absolute error <= 0.05; do not subtract repeatability or substitute KLD

phases.name: Prepare a separate bounded diagnostic
requirements: Pin original model, runtime source, sampler, template, request bytes, token IDs and exact tensor dtype/shape. Preserve consumed v107 and v108 receivers.
Bind capture points result_norm and result_output to the failing first output token, while distinguishing pre-sampler logits from emitted server logprobs.
Verify request token arrays including BOS against the accepted original rendered prompt. Keep batch and ubatch at 256 for the primary comparisons. Any batch-shape probe is a separate arm.
Validate the closure, transport ownership, cancellation, and bounded aggregate host/device retention before physical initialization. A small output tile alone is not a peak proof.
Do not prepare a whole-output F32 BLAS expansion, batch sweep, model download, quantized KV change, or speculative decoding arm.

phases.name: Measure same-stack repeatability and localize first-token drift
requirements: Use two matched cache-off requests per backend on the original short payload to measure CPU-versus-CPU and CUDA-versus-CUDA variation, with one slot, fixed sampler and no co-tenancy. These are new bound diagnostics, not receiver replays.
Capture final normalized hidden vectors and full raw logits. Preserve original token IDs, output bytes, emitted logprobs, and completed GPU operation evidence.

Compare CPU and CUDA logits with a shared host float64 log-softmax calculation. Record selected logit and log normalizer separately, max/percentile raw-logit error, argmax identity and top-two margin. Float64 is a diagnostic calculation, not proof of the true result.
If hidden inputs differ, inspect bounded layer checkpoints from the first divergence; include prefill/recurrent operations rather than attributing all drift to output.weight.

If projection inputs match, compare Q5 output projection on the identical captured input through the CPU Q8_K and CUDA Q8_1 routes and a bounded dequantized arithmetic control. Stream tiles and preserve the full vocabulary normalizer. CPU host controls do not qualify the physical CUDA model.
Report a measured self-floor without subtracting it from the 0.05 threshold. If variation is unexplained, fail the diagnostic and stop broad acceptance work.

phases.name: Change only the evidenced precision cause and rerun the original gate
requirements: Keep any output-projection change separate from recurrent-state, prefill, batch and checkpoint changes.
Review source support and total memory bounds for the exact successor before a new cold operation. Required physical cold-cycle facts and native owner evidence must be current for that operation.
Run the unchanged original request and selected-token comparison once through a newly bound receiver. A correct answer or matching argmax does not bypass a numerical failure.
Measure actual aggregate physical peak and placement before broader coding/research claims.

phases.name: Run original full-tool coding acceptance and observe cached turn correctness
requirements: Execute the original coding pair on this exact accepted candidate with full instructions, tools, actual client version and output reserve. Do not transfer earlier model results.

During the actual sessions record rendered-token common prefix, reasoning/tool serialization, uncached prompt tokens, exact restored checkpoint positions, retained checkpoint bytes, client TTFT and end-to-end turn latency.
Compare a bounded reused-prefix and divergent-prefix replay against a cache-off control. Correct state and unchanged original tolerance must accompany a latency gain.
Treat PR 25592 and PR 26004 as separately reviewed source candidates if the pinned build reproduces the problem. Never apply rejected PR 24797 semantics or assume an upstream flag patches this fork.

phases.name: Complete stability, genuine standard research and deployment
requirements: Use required repeated work sessions for stability; capture device faults, retained memory and equal-work timings. No new benchmark matrix is justified by this review.
Complete the canonical standard /dr source/evidence, blind-ten and refetch-fifteen gates, standalone optimization, render/install/finish and both concept trees. Preserve original contracts.
Only after full acceptance deploy the exact launcher and Explorer route. Keep the protected Apple MLX research fallback distinct.

actions_this_review.semantic_query_embeddings: requested retrieval only; no pooled answer generation
